The Denver Nuggets host the Golden State Warriors with both teams having played two games this season. Denver is 1-1 overall, 1-0 at home, on a one-game win streak, and sits 8th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, one game back. Golden State is 0-2 and has lost two straight, sitting 13th in the West and two games back in the Pacific.

Denver is without Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Golden State is missing Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green (all back), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Stephen Curry (rest). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season and split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with Denver's most recent meeting a 116-93 win in Denver on March 29, 2026.
